links.outcome: NLP model performance versus board-certified anesthesiologists on ASA-PS classification, same test data
links.effect: ClinicalBigBird AUROC 0.915; specificity 0.901 vs 0.897, precision 0.732 vs 0.715, F1 0.716 vs 0.713 compared with anesthesiologists (all p<0.01).
links.quote: It outperformed board-certified anesthesiologists with a specificity of 0.901 vs. 0.897, precision of 0.732 vs. 0.715, and F1-score of 0.716 vs. 0.713 (all p <0.01).

screen.reason: The study evaluates NLP/LLM models (including GPT-4 and ClinicalBigBird) compared directly with board-certified anesthesiologists for ASA-PS classification on clinical notes in a retrospective reader/validation study.
